title: Plurarch pavilion
narrative: A small public pavilion (18 m x 10 m, one room) for talks and exhibitions, in a hot, sunny climate. It should stay comfortable without heavy air-conditioning, feel open and daylit, stay within a modest budget, and keep its embodied carbon low.
metrics_note: All metrics are indicative proxies computed from simple, documented formulas (design_mcp/metrics.py). They are not simulations.

goals.label: Daylight
goals.plain: The room must get enough daylight (daylight index at least 50).

goals.label: Cooling load
goals.plain: The building must not overheat (cooling index at most 62).

goals.label: Cost
goals.plain: It must stay within budget (cost index at most 100).

goals.label: Embodied carbon
goals.plain: Embodied carbon must stay low (carbon index at most 90).

close_tradeoff_note: A goal missed by no more than this many index points is 'marginal': the trade-off is close, so the participants' choice wins.

hard_rules.label: Window ratio at least 25%
hard_rules.plain: Windows must cover at least 25% of the wall, for minimum daylight.

hard_rules.label: Glass façade with 50%+ windows needs shading
hard_rules.plain: In this hot climate, a glass façade with 50% or more windows needs real shading: a shading fraction of at least 0.35 from the roof overhang and the canopy.

consensus.note: Consensus is the winner's share for choice questions, and the share of votes within one step of the median for sliders. Strong (>= 0.70): keep the value unless a hard rule forces a change. Weak (< 0.50): the agent may compromise between leading options (options within 0.10 of the winner's share).

modification_limits.note: A modification is 'reasonable' only within these limits. If no valid design exists within them, the verdict is REJECTED.

agent_limits.note: Up to 5 evaluate calls to explore. One extra evaluate call after set_parameters is allowed for verification.
